'''Assimara Humans''' are the [[:Category:Assimara_Parasites|Assimara Version]] of Zombies/Husks.

== ''Spawning'' ==

* Spawns individually, from [[Evolution Phases#Phase 4|Phase 4]] onward, with a spawnweight of 1, once 5 Zombies/Husks have been assimilated.

== ''Behavior'' ==
Assimara Humans are Offensive Grappler Melee Combatants.

* Their Melee Attack is performed through contact damage, which has a 20% chance to inflict [[Bleeding]] for 5 seconds.
* Assimara Humans will grab their target if in melee range, latching on to their head. This will, apply the [[No Vision]] effect (completely blinding the target), Mining Fatigue, and Speed.
* Any Mob within 3 blocks of an Assimara Humans will be inflicted with [[Call Of The Hive|COTH]]. This does not go through walls.
* Assimara Humans can perform small leaps, both on land and in liquids.
* Assimara Humans are able to dive in liquids to pursue submerged targets.
* On death Assimara Humans have a chance to explode, releasing [[Remains|Assimara Remains]] and an effect cloud of stacking Poison and [[Call Of The Hive|COTH]].

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===
*Assimara Humans, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.
